page.content:
Republican general who defeated Hannibal at Zama.

How Scipio Africanus connects

  • Character: Hannibal — Scipio defeated Hannibal at Zama.
  • Event: Punic Wars — Scipio Africanus ended the Second Punic War in Africa.

What is Scipio Africanus?

Publius Cornelius Scipio took the war to Spain and Africa, won Zama in 202 BCE, and earned the name Africanus — the Punic Wars' Roman counterpart to Hannibal.

Key threads lead to Hannibal and Punic Wars.
